task.title: Reduce large-doc graph warnings
task.summary: Split or trim oversized CodeWiki system docs so graph health no longer reports large-doc warnings.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki graph health no longer reports large-doc warnings for system docs.
acceptance: api.md, graph.md, and overview.md are reduced or split below the lint large-doc threshold.
Any moved detail remains reachable from the original docs through links or focused docs.
Graph/generated-parity audits pass with no large-doc graph-health warnings.
non_goals: Do not change package runtime behavior.
Do not broaden lint thresholds to hide oversized docs.
